Fields.Name: Pad Button
Fields.Description: Default controller button or stick direction of the action. 2900 and 2901 are the two face buttons that follow the system's confirm-button setting: 2900 becomes 2005 and 2901 becomes 2004, the other way round when the setting is reversed.

Fields.Name: Keyboard Modifier Key
Fields.Description: Modifier key held together with Keyboard Key for the action.

Fields.Name: Keyboard Key
Fields.Description: Default keyboard key of the action. -1: none (also skipped by the key configuration's conflict check).

Fields.Name: Mouse Modifier Key
Fields.Description: Modifier key held together with Mouse Button for the action.

Fields.Name: Mouse Button
Fields.Description: Default mouse button or wheel input of the action.

Fields.Name: Name ID
Fields.Description: The name to use for this key assignment.

Fields.Name: Description ID
Fields.Description: The description to use for this key assignment.

Fields.Name: Conflict Group Mask
Fields.Description: Bits 0-2: groups of actions that cannot share a key. Two bindings conflict in the key settings when their masks share a bit. Retail: 1 in-game, 2 menus, 4 map, 5 movement (in-game and map), 7 Main Menu and Map.

Fields.Name: Direction
Fields.Description: For pad sticks. Works for both X and Y axes.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail 0-15 (likely bit flags): 3 on most in-game actions, 11 on Map, Reset Camera and the item and armament switches, 7 on most menu rows.

Fields.Name: Can Be Reassigned
Fields.Description: Set: the binding can be changed in the key settings (on the devices allowed below). Clear: fixed.

Fields.Name: Unknown Flag
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: set on most reassignable bindings, clear on Main Menu, Map and Event Action.

Fields.Name: Reassignable on Pad
Fields.Description: Set: the binding can be changed for the gamepad. Retail: clear on stick movement and on actions without a pad key.

Fields.Name: Reassignable on Keyboard
Fields.Description: Set: the binding can be changed for the keyboard.

Fields.Name: Reassignable on Mouse
Fields.Description: Set: the binding can be changed for the mouse. Retail: clear on Main Menu, movement and map zoom.

Fields.Name: Pad: Use Linked Key
Fields.Description: Set: the gamepad input of this action is taken from the row in Linked Key. Retail: rows 123, 1002 and 1004.

Fields.Name: Keyboard: Use Linked Key
Fields.Description: Set: the keyboard input of this action is taken from the row in Linked Key. Retail: never set.

Fields.Name: Mouse: Use Linked Key
Fields.Description: Set: the mouse input of this action is taken from the row in Linked Key. Retail: never set.

Fields.Name: Linked Key
Fields.Description: Another row of this param whose binding is used for the devices whose Use Linked Key flag is set. -1: none. Retail: 123 -> 122 (Event Action), 1002 -> 204, 1004 -> 205 (the swappable confirm/cancel pad buttons).

Fields.Name: Shared Pad Key
Fields.Description: Pad action shared with this when holding Y/Triangle.
